name: stated_budget_coverage
description: How many deals have a customer-stated budget at all, and the median stated budget against the median quoted value. Call this BEFORE stated_budget_vs_quote and before answering any question about price gaps or customer budgets — it is the denominator that says whether the detail is worth reading. price_limit_mentions counts deals where the customer raised a price limit; with_stated_amount counts the subset where an actual figure was captured, which is much smaller. If with_stated_amount is in single digits, say so plainly and report individual deals rather than any median — the median_stated_budget column exists so the number is visible, not so it can be quoted as representative. Comparing median_stated_budget against median_quoted_value is only meaningful when with_stated_amount is large enough to carry it, and on current data it is not.

params.name: min_mentions
params.description: Only accounts with at least this many price-limit mentions.

params.name: min_with_amount
params.description: Only accounts where at least this many deals captured an actual figure.
